quarterly_data.quarter: Taiyo Holdings annual securities report: FY2026 (06-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Electronics segment drivers in FY2026 (year to March 2026), per management's analysis: sales of semiconductor package (PKG) substrate materials rose on higher volumes - demand grew against the background of the spread of AI, with volumes up mainly in dry film products for memory; rigid board materials volumes rose as automotive and smartphone-related demand was strong, mainly in the China region; volumes of display-related products (white dry film) fell as end-product demand shifted; the stronger yen reduced sales (average rate JPY 150.9 per US dollar vs JPY 152.5 a year earlier). The company states that its main product, solder resist (SR), holds a world top-class market share and that overseas sales exceed 90% of the Electronics business.
quarterly_data.figure: PKG substrate materials volume up (memory dry film, AI demand); average JPY 150.9/USD vs JPY 152.5

quarterly_data.quarter: Taiyo Holdings annual securities report: FY2026 (06-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Medium-term management plan (drawn up August 2025) financial targets for the fiscal year ending March 2031: consolidated net sales JPY 180 billion, consolidated operating profit JPY 47 billion, ROE 30%. ROE was 22.0% in FY2026 (10.6% in FY2025). Management states the electronics industry is strongly influenced by the semiconductor industry, where related demand is expected to expand over the medium to long term on rising semiconductor demand for AI-related products, the full spread of 5G and IoT, and that automotive materials are expected to grow with electrification and autonomous driving.
quarterly_data.figure: FY ending March 2031 targets: net sales JPY 180 billion, operating profit JPY 47 billion, ROE 30%; FY2026 ROE 22.0%

quarterly_data.quarter: Taiyo Holdings annual securities report: FY2026 (06-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D expenses were JPY 7,637 million in FY2026 (up JPY 425 million), of which Electronics JPY 6,603 million. The report states the group's solder resist is widely used on package substrates for major semiconductor devices - CPUs and GPUs in PCs, application processors in mobile devices, DRAM and NAND flash memory - and that adoption of dry-film-type SR is increasing to meet thickness-precision, flatness and opening-precision requirements; it says the PKG substrate market is expanding with semiconductor demand driven by AI data-center demand and vehicle electrification. It is developing materials for next-generation packages: for 2.5D interposers it expects its interposer redistribution-layer insulation materials to be used depending on the structure, and for glass core substrates it states the market has not yet started and it is developing toward future adoption. Low-dielectric interlayer insulation materials for 5G substrates are in customer evaluation, and a film-type encapsulant developed from its interlayer insulation know-how has led to customer adoption.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D JPY 7,637 million (Electronics JPY 6,603 million); glass core substrate market not yet started

quarterly_data.quarter: Taiyo Holdings annual securities report: FY2026 (06-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Product development stated in the FY2026 report: in rigid-board SR, where development focuses on HDI boards used in smartphones and AI servers and on automotive boards, a newly developed low-transmission-loss material (answering 5G-related development requests) has reached the stage of adoption by customers; the company expects thinner films to bring a shift from liquid to dry-film types and has begun introducing a dry-film-type SR to customers; a next-generation automotive-board SR obtained end-customer certification and entered mass production; an inkjet-applied SR and etching resist were adopted by a customer for automotive boards and entered mass production; its next-generation heat-dissipation paste is adopted in an on-board charger converter of a major automotive parts maker; its photosensitive coverlay film is adopted in smartphone cameras and other devices; its products are also adopted on satellite-communication antenna boards.

quarterly_data.quarter: Taiyo Holdings annual securities report: FY2026 (06-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Material contract: on March 31, 2026 the board resolved that, if a tender offer by KJ005 for the company's common shares is launched, the company will express support for it while leaving the decision to tender to shareholders, and the company signed an agreement with KJ005 and its parent KJ005HD the same day; the tender offer and subsequent transactions are aimed at taking the company private, with the support of KKR. Management states going private will let it carry out its value-enhancement measures and make the medium-term plan more executable.
